name: Noterro
tagline: Noterro is a practice management platform for massage therapists, physiotherapists, and other manual-therapy clinics. It generates SOAP notes from a short set of prompts, handles online booking and intake forms, and processes payments, cutting into the paper charting that used to eat up appointment time.
